mapper.sql: WITH net AS ( SELECT e.work_order_id,coalesce(sum(e.amount) FILTER(WHERE e.direction='RECEIVE'),0) receive_net, coalesce(sum(e.amount) FILTER(WHERE e.direction='PAY'),0) pay_net FROM funds_entry e WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM funds_reversal fr WHERE fr.entry_id=e.id) GROUP BY e.work_order_id ), balances AS ( SELECT w.id,w.business_no,w.claim_no,w.status,w.created_at,r.amount receive_target,p.amount pay_target, coalesce(n.receive_net,0) receive_net,coalesce(n.pay_net,0) pay_net FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN net n ON n.work_order_id=w.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT amount FROM funds_target WHERE work_order_id=w.id AND direction='RECEIVE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) r ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT amount FROM funds_target WHERE work_order_id=w.id AND direction='PAY' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) p ON true WHERE w.status<>'DRAFT' ), rows AS ( SELECT *,CASE WHEN receive_target IS NULL THEN 'UNSET' WHEN receive_target=receive_net THEN 'SETTLED' WHEN receive_net=0 THEN 'UNPAID' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END receive_status, CASE WHEN pay_target IS NULL THEN 'UNSET' WHEN pay_target=pay_net THEN 'SETTLED' WHEN pay_net=0 THEN 'UNPAID' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END pay_status FROM balances )
